Tour Ramy Sabry Nov 24, 2026

Ramy Sabry announces a 6-concert tour

Ramy Sabry has announced a six-concert tour, starting Saturday, November 28 at Etihad Arena in Abu Dhabi. The tour continues Dec 11 in Egypt, Dec 12 in Lebanon, Dec 24 in Kuwait, Dec 31 in Egypt, and Jan 15, 2027 at Madinaty Open Air Mall. Cairo Frequency covered it on Instagram with a mention for @ramysabry.

Concert Karim Osama Dec 4, 2026

Karim Osama & El Waili close the Intel Campus Cup final

Karim Osama and El Waili perform at the closing ceremony of the Intel Campus Cup — Egypt's university gaming championship — where Cairo University meets Helwan University in the Valorant final. Doors open at 2:00 PM, and early tickets were offered at EGP 175 via the link in bio.

About Cairo Frequency

What we do

Cairo Frequency is an independent digital news page covering Egyptian and Arab music and celebrity news — new releases, concerts, festivals and the stories artists break on their own channels.

We monitor the artists we cover every 30 minutes, around the clock. When a song drops or a concert is announced, the story goes out on our Instagram first — artwork carrying the news and the CF mark, with the full details in the caption — and the confirmed stories are collected here.

Our coverage is in English, for Arab music fans everywhere.
